page.title: Install blvm
page.lead: Pre-built binaries and Linux packages from GitHub Releases, with checksums.sha256 on every release. Verify before running.

packageSlots.label: Linux x86_64
packageSlots.description: Single static binary for 64-bit Linux (glibc). Full features; no package manager required.

packageSlots.label: Linux tarball
packageSlots.description: Archive with blvm and governance CLIs plus per-artifact checksum files inside.

packageSlots.label: Debian / Ubuntu
packageSlots.description: Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 11+, and any dpkg-based distro.
packageSlots.installCmdTemplate:
sudo dpkg -i {{FILENAME}}
sudo apt-get install -f    # pull in any missing deps

packageSlots.label: Fedora / RHEL
packageSlots.description: Fedora 38+, RHEL 9, CentOS Stream 9, and RPM-based distros.

packageSlots.label: ARM64 binary
packageSlots.description: 64-bit ARM Linux binary (Raspberry Pi 4/5 with 64-bit OS, Apple Silicon Linux VMs, etc.).

packageSlots.label: ARM64 tarball
packageSlots.description: 64-bit ARM Linux archive (Raspberry Pi 4/5, aarch64 servers).

packageSlots.label: Windows
packageSlots.description: Portable Windows 10 / 11 build (64-bit). Run from a terminal after verifying the checksum.
packageSlots.installCmdTemplate: # Download {{FILENAME}}, verify the checksum, then run from PowerShell or cmd.
packageSlots.verifyTemplate:
# PowerShell:
(Get-FileHash {{FILENAME}} -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
# Compare to checksums.sha256 on the release page

packageSlots.label: Windows zip
packageSlots.description: Same Windows binary packaged as a zip archive.
packageSlots.installCmdTemplate:
# Expand-Archive {{FILENAME}}
# Run blvm.exe from the extracted folder
packageSlots.verifyTemplate:
# PowerShell:
(Get-FileHash {{FILENAME}} -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
# Compare to checksums.sha256 on the release page

platforms.name: Umbrel
platforms.description: Available in the Umbrel App Store as "Bitcoin Commons". Runs on a Raspberry Pi or any Linux machine with a one-click node stack.
steps: Open your Umbrel dashboard and go to the App Store.
Search for "Bitcoin Commons" and click Install.
Wait for initial sync to complete; this may take several hours on first run.
Access node settings and RPC credentials from the app detail page.

platforms.name: Docker
platforms.description: Run blvm in a container on any platform that supports Docker or Podman. Official image tagging follows blvm releases when published.
steps: Pull the image: docker pull btccommons/blvm:{{VERSION}}
Create a persistent data volume: docker volume create blvm-data
Run the node: docker run -d --name blvm -v blvm-data:/data -p 8333:8333 -p 8332:8332 btccommons/blvm:{{VERSION}}
